review: Independent review of the current unpublished integrated NUM/JOS staging snapshot. Checks only the requested context splits, source-map relevance, source-bound explicit place aliases, and runtime-resolution implications. This is not semantic approval of all content and does not authorize publication.

checks.basisJa: Pinned WEB NUM26:29 names Machir as Gilead’s father and immediately names the Gilead family; NUM26:30 names Gilead’s sons and family groups. The integrated catalog keeps both the base individual and collective context at 26:29–30. At NUM27:1 the Gilead personal lineage remains separately in base while the collective profile does not claim that occurrence. This matches the text’s dual usage.

WEB JOS13:31,17:1,17:2 each contains an ancestor Manasseh and a descendant/tribal context; the base and individual context both retain those dual coordinates. WEB17:3 is genealogy only, and it appears in the individual context while the base collective passage is removed. The current integrated text carries the repaired 17:2 wording. The independent corrected-source closure is recorded separately.

WEB JOS15:6 and18:17 say “the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben,” not the Reubenite collective. Both coordinates are absent from the collective base and present in the cautious unidentified-eponym context. At those verses runtime selects that context; no second base occurrence is added.

WEB14:4 explicitly says Joseph’s children are two tribes, so the base is collective from 14:4. Individual Joseph is separate at17:1–2 and the two uses coexist at24:32. The staged profile uses one entity occurrence at a given coordinate; the app resolver shows context notes where both base and context overlap, avoiding a duplicate pin.

checks.id: JOS explicit alias deduplication and gate
checks.basisJa: All four alias relations are explicit in WEB and the occurrence rewrite produces one canonical occurrence at each alias coordinate with no alias-ID occurrence, so double pins are avoided. Alias facts are gated at their revelation verses. However the builder appends alias source IDs to the canonical profile while retaining source objects whose knownBy is null; EntityProfileCatalog.resolve includes sources with null knownBy before the alias gate. The staged source list therefore exposes alias-linked Wikipedia/geographic-reference sources before the corresponding alias is named. In addition, each of four targets already has a fact at the alias coordinate and receives another fact from the alias summary, producing duplicate reader facts.

aliasGateEvidence.sourceGateImplementation: EntityProfileCatalog.resolve filters source knownBy only when non-null; it computes displayed sources from the selected profile sourceIds plus displayed facts/contexts. Alias builder appends old.sourceIds to canonical target without assigning alias knownBy to source objects.
